title: os validate / os verify name Enterprise-only vocabulary (hierarchy scopes) on Community instead of letting it fail closed silently
body:
## 维护者速读
社区版里，如果应用用了只有企业版才生效的写法，比如按组织架构控制可见范围的 `unit`、`unit_and_below`、`own_and_reports`，现在会静默失效：检查照样通过，运行时按「只看自己的记录」处理，没有任何提示。AI 按规范写出这样的元数据后，用户不会知道它在社区版上不起作用。这张卡要让 `os validate` / `os verify` 在这种情况下直接点名：「这需要 ObjectOS 企业版」。

Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer directed. Filed by the `repo:www.objectos.ai` seat, session `session_01FeA1nwBz1ohH65dvffUGKr`. **Priority: P2.**

## Source
The maintainer, 2026-11-17, reviewing the edition split for the www pricing page (www.objectos.ai #473), chose this follow-up: 「os verify 点名企业版能力」. The review found that metadata which is legal in the spec but enforced only by an Enterprise resolver passes every check on Community and then does nothing.

## Problem
- `hierarchy-security` is an Enterprise capability: `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`, lines 231–235.
- With no resolver present, the sharing service "fails CLOSED to owner-only": `packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`, lines 774–779.
- docs.objectos.ai `configure/permissions/hierarchy-visibility.mdx` line 149 says that on Community "the scopes behave as own".
- Result: an agent that follows the spec writes `readScope: 'unit_and_below'`. `os validate` and `os verify` pass, and on Community every user silently sees only their own records. Nobody is told why.

## Change
- In `os validate` (author-time) and the `os verify` report, flag every use of a capability whose enforcer is Enterprise-only when the app runs without it.
  - Name the capability and the edition, for example: "`unit_and_below` needs ObjectOS Enterprise (hierarchy security); on Community it behaves as owner-only."
  - Severity is open. Recommendation: a warning by default and an error under `--strict`. If the maintainer prefers a hard refusal, use the "loud refusal" that the planned data-markings design already specifies.
- Drive it from one table. Use the capability registry's edition tags, not a hard-coded list, so that later Enterprise vocabulary (data markings, purpose limits) is covered automatically.
- Do not change runtime behaviour. Fail-closed stays.

## Acceptance
- A fixture app on Community with `unit_and_below` gets the named finding in both `os validate` and `os verify --json`. The same app with the capability present gets no finding.
- Self-test fixtures cover each Enterprise-only vocabulary item in the registry.
- The skills and docs that describe hierarchy scopes say which edition enforces them.
